## Cadente v0.2.93-beta.11

- Channel: `unstable`
- Commit: `0ce8218f`
- Changes since: `v0.2.93`

- Allow any assistant to join parallel work without setup so sessions never mix changes (`808b7872`)

- Add launcher self update so a changed launcher installs with one click (`5ecb1e24`)

- Improve terminal startup so the typing field always appears on first open (`c725e92e`)
- Keep parallel commits whole when the command that started them is interrupted (`7b8c8df7`)
- Keep the evidence rule from being relaxed in steps so product changes stay verified (`3c1348a3`)

- Improve terminal sessions so changing a plugin never restarts open terminals (`9c4f855c`)
- Improve deleting terminals so removing a closed or open terminal always works (`68b2bf31`)
- Improve terminals after interactive programs so the typing field returns when the prompt does (`973cf40c`)
- Improve split terminal so dividing a terminal opens side-by-side panes reliably (`736983a9`)
- Improve terminal cemetery and lifecycle so closed tabs delete reliably and appear grayed out (`0ce8218f`)

### Documentation
- Clarify the native interface migration so existing workflows stay intact (`2c32c806`)
- Clarify the plan to remove free plan limits so creating terminals is never blocked (`7f3e6585`)

### Tests
- Improve update verification so stable releases are checked in CI (`687b0cef`)
- Restore regression checks removed by mistake so earlier fixes stay protected (`af916e18`)

### Maintenance
- Improve parallel work so several sessions share one checkout without mixing changes (`44bed853`)
- Remove dead legacy files and caches so the repository stays clean (`ed6a3cd0`)
- Remove dead legacy components and fix shortcut import so repository stays clean (`ac8fd3be`)
- Keep the parallel work rules improving so every session fixes what it finds (`ea7d43d2`)
